desc:
Welcome to +1 Speed Steal From Brainrot!💨

⚡ HOW TO PLAY:

🏃‍♂️ Run & Get Faster! Gain +1 Speed EXP for every second you run! (You can upgrade this multiplier to get faster, quicker 📈).

🤫 Infiltrate the Base! Sneak into the enemy territory and snatch a Brainrot right from under their noses!

💨 Outrun the Horde! Use your stacked speed to escape the raging Brainrots that will chase you down!

💤 AFK Grinding! Need a break? Equip a Treadmill to train your speed automatically, even while you are standing still or AFK!

💰 Bring your stolen Brainrots back to your base to stack that cash and buy epic upgrades!

⭐ Having fun? 👍 Like the game, favorite it, and invite your friends to race! 😄
